meta_title: CJC Decor Services | Painter & Decorator Southampton
meta_description: CJC Decor Services in Southampton. Professional interior and exterior painting, decorating, and wallpapering. Free quotes. Call 07761 737925.
hero_subhead: From tired walls to transformed rooms. We handle interior redecorating, exterior painting, and wallpapering with precision and care.
services_subhead: Whether you're refreshing a single room or redecorating your entire home, we handle interior and exterior projects with attention to detail.

services.title: Interior Painting & Redecorating
services.desc: Living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens, and bathrooms painted to a professional finish. We move furniture, protect floors, and clear up fully after each job.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Cladding
services.desc: Weatherproof exterior walls, fascias, soffits, and doors. We use quality paints that stand up to Southampton's coastal climate and last years.

services.title: Wallpapering & Feature Walls
services.desc: Precise hanging of luxury wallpapers, murals, and feature walls. Includes surface preparation and removal of old paper.

services.title: Woodwork & Trim Finishing
services.desc: Skirting boards, doors, window frames, and exposed beams painted or stained to enhance your home's character.

services.title: Textured & Specialty Finishes
services.desc: Polished plaster, Venetian effects, faux finishes, and bespoke colour matching to bring depth and personality to your rooms.

services.title: Preparation & Surface Work
services.desc: Expert filling, sanding, and priming to ensure smooth, long-lasting results. We don't cut corners on the work you don't see.

about_pullquote: We treat every home as if it's our own — no shortcuts, no mess left behind.
about_para_1: CJC Decor Services was founded on a simple idea: that a fresh coat of paint shouldn't mean disruption, dirt, or cowboys. Over 15 years, we've built a reputation for showing up on time, doing the work right, and leaving your home spotless. We're based in Totton and serve Southampton and the surrounding New Forest area.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we listen to what they want, explain our approach upfront, and deliver without fuss. We use quality materials, protect your furnishings and floors, and take pride in the detail. That's why so many of our work comes from word-of-mouth and repeat bookings.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Brilliant bloke. Arrived on time, got straight to work, and the finish is perfect. My living room looks completely transformed. Couldn't ask for better workmanship. Definitely booking him again for the bedrooms.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had Craig decorate three rooms and the hallway. He was tidy, professional, and didn't rush the job. Gave a fair quote and stuck to it. The walls are beautifully smooth and the colour is exactly what I wanted. Can't recommend him enough.
reviews.author: Elizabeth P.

reviews.text: Exterior needed painting badly before winter. Craig sorted the lot — fascias, soffits, and the front door. Quality materials, no mess, finished on schedule. That was six months ago and it still looks fresh. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: David K.
